description: Source code for the Mattermost Elasticsearch indexing job worker, including worker management, job processing, batch indexing of posts, channels, users, and files, and progress tracking.

classes.name: IndexerWorker
classes.description: Worker responsible for managing Elasticsearch indexing jobs, including batch processing and progress tracking.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker goroutine to process jobs and handle cancellation signals.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the worker gracefully, waiting for ongoing processes to finish.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel for submitting jobs to the worker.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the worker is enabled based on license and configuration.

methods.name: initEntitiesToIndex
methods.description: Initializes which entities (posts, channels, users, files) to index based on job data.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Claims and processes a single indexing job, including batch indexing and progress updates.

methods.name: IndexBatch
methods.description: Determines which batch to process next based on job data and progress.

methods.name: IndexPostsBatch
methods.description: Fetches a batch of posts for indexing and performs bulk indexing.

methods.name: BulkIndexPosts
methods.description: Indexes a batch of posts into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: IndexFilesBatch
methods.description: Fetches a batch of files for indexing and performs bulk indexing.

methods.name: BulkIndexFiles
methods.description: Indexes a batch of files into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: IndexChannelsBatch
methods.description: Fetches a batch of channels for indexing and performs bulk indexing.

methods.name: BulkIndexChannels
methods.description: Indexes a batch of channels into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: IndexUsersBatch
methods.description: Fetches a batch of users for indexing and performs bulk indexing.

methods.name: BulkIndexUsers
methods.description: Indexes a batch of users into Elasticsearch.

methods.name: initProgress
methods.description: Initializes indexing progress state based on job data and current time.

methods.name: parseStartTime
methods.description: Parses or determines the start time for indexing.

methods.name: parseEndTime
methods.description: Parses or determines the end time for indexing.

methods.name: parseDoneCount
methods.description: Parses progress counts from job data.

methods.name: setStartEntityIDs
methods.description: Sets initial entity IDs for progress tracking from job data.

methods.name: entityCountFallback
methods.description: Provides fallback counts for entities if analytics query fails.

methods.name: setEntityCount
methods.description: Sets total entity counts for progress tracking, with fallback on failure.
